findings.detail: Foreign currency marker from the par amount field was carried into fair_value_currency even though the source fair value column is the BDC valuation column expected in USD.

rationale: FX02 is a single-cell fair_value_currency flag. The extracted value is U_EUR, but the raw schedule separates par amount currency from valuation fields: cited rows place EUR in the par amount slot, while cost/amortized cost and fair value are reported in the valuation columns that roll to USD schedule totals. The source therefore supports USD for fair_value_currency and shows the EUR unit was taken from the wrong field. Exact row_key-to-issuer mapping is not exposed in the bundle, so confidence is below perfect, but the source pattern directly grounds the defect.
